title: Customer Readiness Runbook — Beta + Lighthouse Program
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Prepare and coordinate customer-facing readiness for the Q2 Beta and Lighthouse account program. Deliverables include a launch readiness checklist, release notes coordination, QA validation matrix, assignment of owners across Eng/Design/Support/Sales, and a rapid feedback loop for post-release quality monitoring. This ticket centralizes the cross-functional work required to move 8 initial lighthouse accounts through onboarding to measurable success criteria.
acceptance_criteria: All lighthouse accounts scheduled and invited in pilot portal
Release notes draft reviewed by Eng and Legal and published to staging docs
Support runbook and escalations owned and uploaded to internal playbook
Feedback collection pipeline created (forms + dashboards) and tested with 2 pilot responses
Success metrics defined and dashboard showing baseline values
launch_tasks: Finalize Beta eligibility criteria and compile initial invite list — Owner: Ethan Liu
Create customer onboarding checklist with step-by-step API keys, SDK snippets, and region config — Owner: Priya Kapoor (Solutions)
Draft release notes summary and breaking changes section; coordinate review with ENG and Legal — Owner: Noah Chung (PM)
Prepare Support & SRE runbook (escalation matrix, hotfix plan) — Owner: Miguel Santos (Support Lead)
Schedule Lighthouse kickoff calls and collect success objectives per account — Owner: Amelia Ross (Customer Success)
Instrument feedback pipeline: short survey, auto-tagging of tickets, Slack ingestion channel — Owner: Data Platform (ENG-3399)
Create canary rollout plan and rollback criteria for the first 48 hours — Owner: Release Eng (ENG-3412)
Coordinate SDK patch release and publish changelog; link to examples repo — Owner: SDK Team
Prepare FAQ and example prompts tailored to high-latency/regulated customers — Owner: Design
Validate observability dashboards (latency, error rate, token cost delta) and set alert thresholds — Owner: Observability Team
release_notes_outline: Overview: What changed and why it matters to customers
Compatibility: supported model variants and SDK versions
Link to full technical changelog and example code snippets
Beta limitations and SLA expectations for pilot accounts
feedback_loop_plan: T+0–48h: real-time Slack channel for pilot teams, staffed by on-call engineer
T+3 days: automated short survey emailed to account admins; results ingested to dashboard
Weekly syncs with Lighthouse account PMs for first 4 weeks
Bi-weekly internal debrief with Eng/Design/Support to triage top issues and assign fixes
Issue tagging taxonomy: quality/regression/perf/security to prioritize fixes
Customer-facing change log updates after each critical fix

success_criteria: At least 6/8 lighthouse accounts complete onboarding checklist within 30 days
Average generation latency within promised SLO (95th percentile) for 90% of requests
No P0 incidents attributable to this release during the first 14 days
Customer satisfaction NPS >= 7 from pilot survey after 30 days
No major regressions in token cost per request beyond 10% of baseline
monitoring_metrics: 95th percentile latency by route and model
Error rate (5xx) and client error rate (4xx) by API key
Token cost delta vs baseline by model
Number of active lighthouse sessions per account
Feedback sentiment score from survey (scale -1 to +1)
rollout_schedule: 2026-03-18: Publish release notes to staging and notify internal teams
2026-03-20: Invite lighthouse accounts to pilot portal; schedule kickoff calls
2026-03-22: Canary rollout to 5% of traffic for lighthouse accounts only
2026-03-24: Expand to 25% if no P0 failures and performance within SLOs
2026-03-28: Full beta availability for invited customers and begin broader opt-ins
2026-04-15: Post-pilot review and decision on GA readiness
communications: Internal: #beta-launch Slack channel, daily 15-minute standups for first week
External: templated invite email for lighthouse accounts with onboarding checklist link
Release notes: publish short & long versions; tweet-sized summary for product updates
Support: set up dedicated Support queue and tag policy for pilot issues
Sales: prepped one-pager with limitations and uplift opportunities for pilot accounts
risks: Late SDK regression impacting onboarding samples
Insufficient observability for Private deployments leading to blindspots
Customer throughput patterns cause unexpected queuing and latency spikes
Legal review delays to release notes or terms for regulated accounts
Key dependency ENG-3399 (feedback ingestion) slips by 1 sprint
mitigations: Hold a pre-beta freeze on non-critical SDK changes 72 hours before invite
Add temporary increased tracing for Private customers and rotate out after pilot
Implement strict canary caps and automated rollback if latency or error thresholds breached
Parallelize legal sign-off by providing a short technical appendix for fast review
Create contingency: manual ingestion of feedback CSVs if ENG-3399 misses target
qa_plan: Create a customer-facing test plan with 12 canonical prompts across model variants
Validate SDK flows (auth, region selection, streaming) in dedicated QA accounts
Run load test for typical lighthouse traffic patterns (burst + sustained) and capture KV cache hit rates
Smoke tests for Private/VPC deploys: RBAC, KMS integration, and audit log generation
Pre-flight checklist sign-off from Eng, Observability, Support, and Solutions
